10.  Enteral formulas supplemented with glutamine are designed to accomplish which of the 
following?
a. Decrease inflammation
b. Improve glucose control
c. Promote immune function and improve bowel integrity
d. Normalization of BUN and creatinine
11.  How can the risk of aspiration be reduced in a patient receiving enteral tube feeding?
a. Feed into the stomach
b. Elevate head of bed to greater than 30 degrees
c. Feed at night only
d. Hold tube feeding for gastric residual >200
12.  What is the most commonly reported GI complication for a patient receiving tube feeding?
a. Nausea/ vomiting
b. Constipation
c. Reflux
d. Diarrhea
